description.narrative: The PDO are to: (a) improve the reliability of electricity supply in project areas; (b) increase access to grid and off-grid electricity services in Togo; and (c) improve the commercial performance of the distribution company CEET.

The development objective of Inclusive Development Through Electricity Access Project for Togo is to: (a) improve the reliability of electricity supply in project areas; (b) increase access to electricity services in project areas; and (c) improve the commercial performance of the distribution company CEET. This project has three components. 1) The first component, Construction of climate-resilient transmission lines, will finance (a) the construction of the top priority transmission line in the masterplan, a 161 kV HV line between DaviE, NotsE, KpalimE, and AtakpamE (DANOKA). 2) The second component, Electricity access expansion through grid and off-grid solutions in rural and urban areas, has the following sub-components: (i) Grid extension and densification in urban and peri-urban areas; (ii) Extension of the electricity grid in rural areas; and (iii) Financing of grid and off-grid electricity access costs. 3) The third component, Institutional capacity building, utility performance improvement and project implementation support, has the following sub-components: (i) Utility operational improvement; and (ii) Institutional strengthening, technical assistance, and project implementation support.
